metadata_evidence.locator: PDF p.8, Methods: Tree data and Modelling density, diversity, and richness patterns
metadata_evidence.supports: April2023 ATDN compilation; old-growth/undisturbed forest plots; trees with DBH at least10cm; 0.5-2ha plots retained; richness standardized to hectare with Fisher-alpha formula.

decisions: Keep the native spatial grid accessible through a geometry-null Item; nonspatial is catalog admission mode only.
No datum was inferred from coordinate ranges or software defaults.
The interpolated values describe the model surface; tree counts and species counts have not been rounded to integers.
limitations: Published article, deposited scripts and repository metadata did not provide an explicitCRS/datum. Degree-like coordinates establish neither WGS84 nor another datum.
The original script may rely on package-default geographic handling; that is not an explicit author-supplied datum declaration.
Supplement PDF retrieval was attempted viaPMC and publisher static-content URLs but was unavailable in this environment; supplementary figures were not used as CRS evidence.

interpretation.population: Old-growth/undisturbed forest inventory plots; free-standing woody individuals with DBH >=10cm.
interpretation.map_scope: Interpolated attributes over the original lowland forest extent, not a current forest-cover map.
interpretation.richness_basis: Species richness per hectare uses Fisher alpha and trees per hectare to standardize plots of differing area.

next_step: Obtain an author or repository CRS statement and then losslessly encode the native grid as a GeoTIFF.
